observations.why: Justifies the gate by proportionality — two violations caused the gate; the consequence is framed as a measured response to a counted cost, enacting market-pricing.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Restates the gate as a formal requirement — authority-ranking enacted through a mandatory precondition declared by the position-holder.
Extends the gate's jurisdiction across environments — authority-ranking enacted by specifying the scope of hierarchical control.
